clips.title: The story
paras: Zangen Stonehoof sends the Horde after a sacred flame and an ancient relic. To aid Rau Cliffrunner in Thousand Needles, you seek a moonwell phial in Ashenvale.

The Galak centaur guard an ancient relic in Thousand Needles. Their artifact dates to the creation of their race, and they protect it with sacred flames. Zangen Stonehoof needs water touched by lunar divinity to extinguish those flames. He sends you north to Ashenvale, where the ancestral forests hold the moonwell water he seeks.

Pure moonwell water needs a vessel that will not corrupt it. You seek an etched phial from the Laughing Sisters, dryads near Raynewood Retreat. Then you submerge the phial in a moonwell along the western banks of the Falfarren River and carry it back to Mulgore.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Galak centaur in the Thousand Needles are protecting an artifact from the time of the centaurs' creation.
We would like to retrieve it, but we require a phial of water from one of the night elves' moonwells.

To collect the water, you will first need to obtain one of the phials carried by the dryads near the Raynewood Retreat in the heart of Ashenvale Forest. There is a moonwell near the western bank of the Falfarren River, south of the main road, where you can fill the phial.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Once we have the filled phial, we can send it along to my associate, Rau, in the Thousand Needles. He was the one who requested the phial of water, so he'll better know how we can make use of it.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Very good. This should fill Rau's request just fine. Could you deliver this to him? You might enjoy spending some time out in the Needles.
